主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: NICK) filed an amendment to its Form 8-K to correct a typographical error in the Portfolio Summary table. The error affected the data for the nine months ended December 31, 2015 and 2014. The corrected information was included in the Press Release furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to the amendment. The company also reported that for the three months ended December 31, 2015, diluted net earnings increased 17% to $0.35 per share, compared to $0.30 for the same period in 2014. Net earnings were $2,727,000 for 2015 and $3,769,000 for 2014. Revenue increased 4% to $22,757,000 for the three months ended December 31, 2015, compared to $21,800,000 for the same period in 2014. The Form 8K Amendment No 1, dated February 1, 2016, was filed by Nicholas Financial, Inc. (Registrant). The document includes the signature of Ralph T. Finkenbrink, who serves as Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer, and Katie L. MacGillivary, who is Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Principal Financial Officer and Accounting Officer. The filing includes an exhibit index with Exhibit 99.1, which is a press release dated January 28, 2016. This press release is likely related to significant events or disclosures that the company is required to report under SEC regulations.
